name: singlet_ingest_quant_spliced_unspliced_counting
title: Spliced, unspliced and ambiguous molecule counting
description: Assigns each deduplicated molecule of one single-cell or single-nucleus library to the spliced, unspliced or ambiguous state of its gene, writing layers/spliced, layers/unspliced and layers/ambiguous per cell. Requires an intron-augmented reference, a read mapping compatible with the chosen method, and collapsed molecules from ingest-quant.umi_deduplication. The default alevin_fry_usa_cr_like is the proposed standard. Do not use it to decide whether intronic reads enter whole-cell totals, or to fit velocity: it supplies the counts those models consume.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI, or a workspace handle; it must hold the outputs of the feeding tasks.

method.description: Counting logic, ported from the named published counter. Default alevin_fry_usa_cr_like is the proposed standard.

device.description: All counters run on CPU; this tool exposes no CUDA path.

threads.description: CPU threads for read and molecule processing; omit to use all available cores.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without writing.

overwrite.description: Replace existing spliced, unspliced and ambiguous layers instead of failing.

sa_model.description: Splicing-ambiguity model; applies only to alevin_fry_usa_cr_like_em.

max_intron_span.description: Introns longer than this do not mark an alignment intronic.

min_overlap.description: Bases an alignment must overlap an exon or intron to be classified.

min_flank.description: Bases a read must overlap an exon or intron to be classified.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. layers/spliced. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: method, reference_release, n_cells, n_features, spliced_molecules, unspliced_molecules, ambiguous_molecules, intronic_fraction_median. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
